limits: Focused native Apple Silicon/Stata 19 development. No frozen F0, SCC, Windows, release qualification, push or installed-plugin replacement.
No performance claim: this is a report-aggregation fix. Correctness captures contain timings but were not used as speed evidence.

The large serial reproduction now passes complete pinned reference and exact repetitions. The seven-thread command gets beyond the old report failure but still fails exact within-process repetition; its capture remains failed evidence.
Explicit-diagonal LSMR certificate failures and other parallel repeat failures remain separate open issues; their tolerances and acceptance rules were not changed.

The weighted regression oracle checks coefficients, covariance, residuals, fitted values, normalized saved FEs and fast/low parity at pool sizes 1/5/10. It uses the same automatic commands and scientific bounds as the failed baseline fixture.
Historical receipts remain unchanged. The known broad repository-checker failures were not rerun or changed.
scientific_policy: Only certified automatic LSMR/flagged-CG reports with identical nonempty LSMR preconditioner metadata may mix. Existing numerical algorithms, certificates, budgets, iteration/timing aggregation and warning order are unchanged. Prior report-only failures may now pass remaining estimation checks. Unaffected captures require exact science.
